question.en: Discuss the role of private sector banks in the transformation of the Indian banking landscape since the 1991 reforms.
question.hi: Discuss the role of private sector banks in the transformation of the Indian banking landscape since the 1991 reforms.

structure.en: Introduction: Mention the 1991 Narasimham Committee reforms.
structure.hi: Introduction: Mention the 1991 Narasimham Committee reforms.

structure.en: Body: Discuss technology adoption, customer service, and competition.
structure.hi: Body: Discuss technology adoption, customer service, and competition.

structure.en: Conclusion: Summarize their contribution to financial inclusion and efficiency.

introduction.en: The 1991 economic reforms, guided by the Narasimham Committee, marked a paradigm shift in the Indian banking sector by allowing the entry of new private sector banks.
introduction.hi: The 1991 economic reforms, guided by the Narasimham Committee, marked a paradigm shift in the Indian banking sector by allowing the entry of new private sector banks.

body.en: Private banks introduced modern technology, such as core banking solutions and internet banking, which forced public sector banks to modernize. They improved customer service standards and introduced innovative financial products. Furthermore, they have been instrumental in expanding financial inclusion through digital channels and reaching underserved segments.
body.hi: Private banks introduced modern technology, such as core banking solutions and internet banking, which forced public sector banks to modernize. They improved customer service standards and introduced innovative financial products. Furthermore, they have been instrumental in expanding financial inclusion through digital channels and reaching underserved segments.

conclusion.en: In conclusion, private banks have acted as catalysts for efficiency and innovation, significantly enhancing the competitiveness and robustness of the Indian banking system.
conclusion.hi: In conclusion, private banks have acted as catalysts for efficiency and innovation, significantly enhancing the competitiveness and robustness of the Indian banking system.
